messages:
tom_sales: Heads up — VerdantAI trial cutover window is scheduled for Tue 03/09. Need clear owners for infra changes, SDK integration, and security signoff. Quick status update + any CRs we should know about? cc @maria_se @kevin_eng

maria_se: SE here — taking point on SDK integration. Most of the client shim is done; waiting on infra to open the egress rules so we can run end-to-end tests. Can we get a staging run Mon 03/08 morning PT?

kevin_eng: Eng - I'll take infra ownership. Opening a CR for the RBAC tweak now. @ria_oncall can you review the egress rule when I post it? I'll add the firewall details to the PR. Link: https://git.redwood/verdantai/integration/merge/42

ria_oncall: oncall - I can review. What exactly are the CIDR ranges and ports required? paste the minimal rule here and I'll fast-track approval.

kevin_eng: eng: Minimal egress we need:```
# allow verdantai staging to reach model endpoints
cidrs: ["10.48.0.0/16", "52.23.120.0/24"]
ports: [443, 8443]
protocol: tcp
```

maria_se: SE - testing plan: we'll run a 10m staging load at ~50 rps to exercise batching and KV cache. Model variant should be pinned to verdant-model@v1.2.1 for parity with baseline. pinging @alex.s for model-pin timing. Also adding perf checks to runbook.

alex.s: infra/model - I can pin the model. Prefer to do it during the Mon staging run so we can catch regressions before the Tue cutover. Available 02:00-04:00 UTC Mon. If Mon is tight, can also do Tue 02:00 UTC after green run.

jamie_pm: pm - I'll review and approve the acceptance criteria by EOD today. Primary success criteria to validate in staging: 99p latency < 400ms, error rate < 0.5%, and embedding cosine distance within 0.6 vs baseline. I'll upload the checklist to the trial Confluence.

maria_se: ACK — adding the perf targets and test cases to the runbook and PR description.

kevin_eng: CR #512 opened for RBAC + egress rule. @maria_se pls paste your SE regression testcases into the PR description so they run as part of the staging checklist.

maria_se: done — testcases added. Also adding a quick curl smoke test for the shim:```
curl -X POST "https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"verdant-model@v1.2.1","input":"test prompt"}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy for service verdantai-integration started by @kevin_eng (build 2026.03.05-78).

ria_oncall: oncall - I approved firewall FR-2296 for the CIDRs above and opened a short maintenance window Mon 10:00-10:30 PT to allow the staging run.

tom_sales: sales - I'll notify VerdantAI about the Mon staging slot at 10:00 PT. Any unresolved blockers? If not, we'll target Mon run -> Tue cutover. :thumbsup:

alex.s: alex - LGTM from model side. If the Mon run passes with the perf criteria Jamie listed, we'll proceed with Tue 02:00 UTC cutover.

kevin_eng: eng - I'll merge CR #512 after the SE testcases pass in staging. Leaving the PR in review until then.

jamie_pm: pm - Thanks everyone. I'll post the signed acceptance checklist here after my review.

tom_sales: sales - Great. Closing loop: staging Mon 10:00 PT, cutover Tue 02:00 UTC contingent on green run. I'll follow up with the customer calendar invite.
